scope: Publish only the already retained V5 original records. No V6, no tests, no source edits, no merge, and no existing remote reference update.

original_archive.origin: Parent-reported verified V5 output. This preparation did not read the remote archive; the exact program validates these pins and every member before any push.

exact_tree_delta.source_tree_rule: Load the entire parent index, add exactly the four named evidence blobs and exact allowlist postimage, then require git diff-tree to equal A4 + M1. No checkout or parent source mutation.
exact_tree_delta.archive_allowlist_rule: The original 11418 bytes remain a prefix and exactly one 162-byte SHA256/path line is appended; no global 512000-byte limit or checker changes. The 715 allowlist postimage must not replace a different staging parent.

validation_planned_by_request: Require a fresh private work directory and the exact clean 715 source/head/tree; fingerprint all source refs before and after.
Reject redirected Git repository ownership environment and optimized Python execution that would skip assertions; do not change credentials, proxies, permissions, existing configuration, or AGENTS.
Read the existing archive/export.json as stable regular single-link files and preserve their original bytes; compare archive size/SHA256/Git blob to the fixed pins.

Read the archive without extracting files. Reject non-regular, duplicate, absolute or traversal member names. Verify 182 members, 181 manifest payloads, every complete payload byte length/SHA256/Git blob, and each of the seven original terminal statuses/digests.
Reconstruct every original export.json field from the pinned archive/manifest and compare full JSON values, while publishing its original raw bytes.
Use an independent shared no-checkout clone and original read-tree; all object/index/local-reference writes remain in that new repository.
Verify the original allowlist bytes, mode 100644 and exact one-line append; preserve all existing exceptions and reject oversized additional evidence metadata.
Create one commit with the fixed 715 parent and the exact five-path tree delta using the explicit machine author Hepta qualification evidence <qualification@local.invalid>.
Before push, require remote branch absence, unchanged source fingerprints and unchanged original archive/export bytes.

Make exactly one push attempt with empty expected lease, one full refspec, --no-follow-tags and --recurse-submodules=no. No --no-verify, credential fallback, automatic push retry, merge or other remote refspec.
Read only that exact remote ref after push; require its commit to match. On failure/unknown outcome retain original output and permit only a read-only same-ref reconciliation.
Recheck original source and archive/export bytes in finally; keep complete command argv, stdout/stderr, exit/status and hashes plus RESULT.json in the independent records directory.
command_wait_scope: The new transport request bounds ordinary Git subprocesses at 180 seconds and its single push at 300 seconds. These are publication transport budgets; no existing native/test timeout is changed. A timed-out push remains uncertain and is never retried.

publication_metadata_semantics.original_export_request: The existing 199062-byte V5 operator request is copied byte-for-byte from its fixed Git blob.
publication_metadata_semantics.current_publication_request: PUBLICATION.json reconstructs the current full h request from actual sys.orig_argv and declared transport fields, explicitly labelled reconstructed and not an MCP response. The separately persisted request digest permits comparison.
publication_metadata_semantics.pre_push_only: The evidence commit contains pre-push verification only. The final real push result and source-after check remain in the separate records/RESULT.json and may later be retained as another evidence artifact.

instructions_read.nested_agents_at_target_ancestors: Four fixed-715 target-ancestor AGENTS reads returned NOT_FOUND; no instruction files changed.

superseded_preparation_only.reason: Final program additionally rejects Python optimization and checks original allowlist mode; do not start the superseded request.
